blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: The tests cover several core behaviors, but do not exercise many specified requirements such as most boundary constraints, missing keys and invalid field types, regular-file filtering, CSV quoting, full deterministic ordering, or all metrics and rejection cases.
advice: test_deps_in_image: The Dockerfile installs and caches pytest during image construction with uvx, even though pytest is a verifier-only dependency; tests/test.sh should be the place that installs or invokes test-only dependencies.
